jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Nova Credit is the industry’s leading cash flow intelligence platform, enabling businesses to unlock the power of cash flow data in how they operate. The company leverages its industry-leading data infrastructure, innovative intelligence layer, & robust FCRA-compliance to boost approvals, improve offers, fight fraud, drive responsible growth, and more. Nova Credit supports over 7,000 businesses including organizations such as Chase, HSBC, SoFi, Sallie Mae, Appfolio, and Yardi, with a growing suite of products. Nova Credit is proud to be backed by an exceptional group of investors and was named in Forbes’ Fintech 50 in 2025 and Built In’s Best Places to Work, 2025 .

THE OPPORTUNITY

We're seeking a Senior Product Manager with 6+ years of experience to drive 0 to 1 product motions and new business at Nova Credit. This is a builder's role for someone who has taken products from a blank page to first customers and first revenue. You'll help identify and validate new opportunities, contribute to standing up new product lines and verticals, and build the platform capabilities that let new bets scale.

You'll navigate ambiguity with strong ownership, partnering closely with company leadership, GTM/Strategic Partnerships, and Engineering to turn early signals into shipped, revenue-generating products. You may also flex into supporting high-priority investments into scaling our Product Platform to better enable adoption of existing functionality across new business lines and markets.

This is a hybrid full-time role (3 days per week in office on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays) based in the New York Metropolitan area, reporting to the Head of Product. We welcome candidates willing to relocate- we provide relocation support to make your move smooth.

WITHIN THE FIRST MONTH, YOU'LL:

- Become familiar with each of our products and how they come together on Nova Credit's Platform.

- Build strong cross-functional partnerships across GTM, Engineering, Data Science, and Solutions Architecture.

- Listen in on customer calls and talk with Strategic Partnerships to map unmet needs to potential solutions.

WITHIN THE FIRST QUARTER, YOU'LL:

- Have a clear understanding of Nova Credit's business model, products, customer needs, and competitors.

- Pressure-test one or two new opportunities through customer discovery, market research, and partnership with our Strategic Partnerships team.

- Define and get cross-functional alignment on what success looks like for an early bet.

WITHIN THE FIRST YEAR, YOU'LL:

- Contribute to taking a new product or bet from concept to first design partners and early revenue.

- Contribute to a repeatable 0 to 1 playbook for validating and launching new bets at Nova Credit.

- Build and maintain strong relationships with strategic cross-functional partners and early customers.

- Contribute to building a strong product culture.

- Contribute to annual roadmapping and Nova Credit's long-term product vision.

YOUR SKILL SET:

- 6+ years in product management. B2B or B2B2C, with a proven track record of shipping high-performing products.

- Proven 0 to 1 builder. You've launched new products or product lines from scratch, ideally taking something to initial product-market fit.

- Thrives in ambiguity. Without a predefined roadmap, you're scrappy, entrepreneurial, and decisive with incomplete data.

- Discovery-driven. You're strong at customer discovery and problem validation, and can define metrics and instrumentation from zero.

- Data fluency. You write your own SQL queries and build Mixpanel dashboards to inform your decisions.

- Customer obsession. You talk to customers constantly and synthesize their insights with quantitative data to drive strategy and prioritization.

- Cross-functional range. You navigate technical trade-offs with Engineering, debate UX approaches with Design, tie prioritization to revenue for Go-To-Market, and communicate complex concepts to any audience.

SAMPLE PROJECTS:

- Identify, validate, and launch a net-new product or vertical from discovery through first paying customers.

- Run a design-partner or early-access program to drive toward product-market fit.

- Build platform capabilities (e.g., integrations, sandbox, product analytics) that make our products faster to launch and scale with new customers or in new markets.

BONUS QUALIFICATIONS:

- Deep industry knowledge within FinTech, particularly in the credit and risk space, working with consumer-permissioned or credit data.

- Prior experience as a founding PM.

$176,800 - $209,950 a year

The Base Salary Range for U.S.-based candidates and is dependent on individual experience, skills, education, location, and qualifications. We consider all elements of compensation as a part of the value we provide to Novans. This may include: base salary, equity grants, incentive compensation for eligible roles, professional development, flexible PTO, and tenure rewards. We offer U.S.-based Novans competitive, employer-subsidized medical, dental, and vision plans, in addition to mental health and wellness benefits and a range of other benefits & perks.

We are an equal-opportunity employer where everyone is welcome at Nova Credit. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected class, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage all qualified candidates, including those with a criminal history, to apply.

Before submitting your application, please review our  Applicant Privacy Notice to learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal information during the application process.

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Product Manager, Property Management
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Nova Credit is the industry’s leading cash flow intelligence platform, enabling businesses to unlock the power of cash flow data in how they operate. The company leverages its industry-leading data infrastructure, innovative intelligence layer, & robust FCRA-compliance to boost approvals, improve offers, fight fraud, drive responsible growth, and more. Nova Credit supports over 7,000 businesses including organizations such as Chase, HSBC, SoFi, Sallie Mae, Appfolio, and Yardi, with a growing suite of products. Nova Credit is proud to be backed by an exceptional group of investors and was named in Forbes’ Fintech 50 in 2025 and Built In’s Best Places to Work, 2025 .

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re seeking a Staff Product Manager with 8+ years of experience to own and scale Nova Credit’s Property Management vertical. Over the past five-plus years, Nova Credit has processed millions of income verifications for thousands of property management companies — and this role owns the product strategy at the center of that business, spanning across all four of our products today: Income Navigator, Eligibility Compass, Credit Passport, and Cash Atlas.

This is an opportunity to own a vertical end-to-end: setting product strategy, building the roadmap, and shipping products that help housing providers verify applicants faster and more accurately while meeting challenging regulatory requirements. You’ll partner deeply with property management and screening platforms (e.g., Yardi, Appfolio, SafeRent), and work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Compliance, and Go-To-Market. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, B2B2C environment, engages directly with market-rate property managers and affordable-housing operators, and translates their needs into impactful product requirements.

This is a hybrid full-time role (3 days per week in office on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays) based in the New York Metropolitan area, reporting to the Head of Product. We welcome candidates willing to relocate- we provide relocation support to make your move smooth.

WITHIN THE FIRST MONTH, YOU'LL:

- Get deep on the Property Management vertical, learning the fundamentals of the Property Management industry and their use cases for Nova Credit’s product platform..

- Build strong cross-functional partnerships across Engineering, Data Science, Compliance, GTM, and Solutions Architecture.

- Listen in on calls with market-rate property managers and affordable-housing operators, and review customer feedback to understand their pain points and needs.

- Dive into product metrics and company KPIs to find areas for improvement.

- Deliver on at least 1 key feature from the roadmap, while making a preliminary assessment on longer-term goals and priorities.

WITHIN THE FIRST QUARTER, YOU'LL:

- Have a clear understanding of Nova Credit’s business model, the property management landscape and customer needs across market-rate and affordable housing, as well as competitors.

- Define and own the prioritized roadmap for the Property Management vertical that is aligned with company goals and our product vision.

- Set quarterly product goals for the vertical.

WITHIN THE FIRST YEAR, YOU'LL:

- Become the subject matter expert for Nova Credit’s Property Management vertical.

- Launch and iterate on multiple initiatives across our product platform with demonstrated impact to key metrics like adoption and conversion.

- Deepen integrations and partnerships with property management and screening platforms.

- Build and maintain strong relationships with strategic cross-functional partners and key customers.

- Refresh the product strategy for the vertical while contributing to annual roadmapping and Nova Credit’s long-term product vision.

YOUR SKILLSET:

- 6+ years in product management (8+ for Staff), B2B or B2B2C, with a proven track record of shipping high-performing products.

- PropTech / property management background. Direct experience in property management, tenant screening, or affordable housing. (Strongly preferred.)

- Comfort with regulated spaces. You treat compliance such as FCRA / CRA obligations and affordable-housing program requirements as a first-class product concern.

- Data fluency. You write your own SQL queries and build Mixpanel dashboards to inform your decisions.

- Customer obsession. You talk to customers constantly and synthesize their insights with quantitative data to drive strategy and prioritization.

- Cross-functional range. You navigate technical trade-offs with Engineering, debate UX approaches with Design, tie prioritization to revenue for GTM, and communicate complex concepts to any audience.

- Bias toward action. You break ambiguous problems into achievable milestones and drive them to resolution end-to-end, without being beholden to process over outcomes.

BONUS QUALIFICATIONS:

- In-depth industry knowledge in PropTech, or working with consumer-permissioned or credit data within real estate technology.

- Familiarity with affordable-housing programs and compliance (e.g., LIHTC, HUD, Section 8) or income/asset verification workflows.

$220,800 - $251,750 a year (Staff/IC5)
$176,800 - $209,950 a year (Senior/IC4)

This may include: base salary, equity grants, incentive compensation for eligible roles, professional development, flexible PTO, and tenure rewards. We offer U.S.-based Novans competitive, employer-subsidized medical, dental, and vision plans, in addition to mental health and wellness benefits and a range of other benefits & perks.

We are an equal-opportunity employer where everyone is welcome at Nova Credit. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected class, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
